label: PLC 1x32 SC/APC, spliced tail
notes: Insertion loss 17.1 dB is a typical 1:32 PLC cassette: the ideal split of 15.05 dB plus 2.05 dB of excess loss. Both the excess and the total are typical values - the excess is the difference between the two, not a figure from a vendor sheet - and ITU-T G.671's insertion-loss requirement for a 1x32 branching component on a normal-reach span (WR1) is 13.3 dB min / 17.5 dB max, so a cassette you buy may sit up to 0.4 dB above this row. Modelled as a spliced cassette: one splice on the input tail and no connector pair charged, although the "-sca" suffix names the SC/APC-adapter variant. A fully connectorised cassette costs two connectors instead, about 0.5 dB more per splitter. Replace with the purchased cassette's datasheet.
